detection.parameter_rationale: PALM MESS via the skill launchers (1_prepare_inputs -> 2_run_mess_scan -> 3_export_tiers). Templates = the full medium-tier hypoDD catalog; freq band and station caps live in the copied config_<run_id>.py template ([REGION-DEPENDENT] block, user-confirmed). Delivery: independent CC>=0.4/0.6/0.8 catalogs.

post_detection_relocation.parameter_rationale: Joint lite (Eryuan rules): first-round ph2dt dt.ct reused verbatim + MESS-native dt.cc, IDAT=3, OBSCC=4/OBSCT=6, LSQR; launchers 4_build_joint_inputs -> 5_run_hypodd_joint -> 6_parse_joint. Select DAMP with the spatial-evidence rule via --damp-scan (400 confirmed by scan in the Eryuan validation); new events enter only through CC links to their templates.

parameter_rationale.profile: Initial working configuration; inspect regional applicability. No case-specific optimum is implied.
parameter_rationale.region: Researcher-specified analysis extent and datum; review before scientific computation.
parameter_rationale.relocation_ratio: Record source and applicability here when setting vp_vs_ratio. The supplied P/S model may have depth-varying ratios.

focal_mechanism.parameter_rationale: SKHASH v1.1 grid search on PhaseNet+ weighted first-motion polarity + measured S/P amplitude ratios (launchers 1_build_inputs -> 2_cut_event_waveforms -> 3_measure_sp_amplitudes -> 5_run_skhash -> 6_parse_mechanisms). Region-dependent values must be user-confirmed: velocity model (inputs/velocity_p.cre), polarity threshold 0.3 (= HASH impulsive-picks equivalent), delmax, and the reversal list. Run 4_check_polarity_reversal.py first and confirm its evidence table with the user before filling reversal_stations; a reversal is only accepted when post-reversal mechanism agreement jumps above 60%. badfrac=0.1/npolmin=8/nmc=30/dang=5deg/azmax=10/ratmin=2 are method constants (5_run_skhash.py defaults).
